{{Quote|I assume you have a concealed '''micro-scanner''' like me... to make certain you're getting the '''real thing'''.|Han Solo to Crimson Jack|<ref name="MSW15" />}}
'''Micro-scanners''' or '''microsensors''' were miniature [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. The [[Holographic Projector Doubler Suit]] used thousands of them to relay movement data from the suit to the [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector's]] [[Computer/Legends|computer]] brain.<ref name="GFT" /> Micro-scanners could be used to verify [[Star map/Legends|navigation chart]] [[Data-tape/Legends|tapes]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Crimson Jack/Legends|Crimson Jack]] both carried them to their duel in space.<ref name="MSW15" />

[[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] had the controls of his ship, the ''[[Hound's Tooth/Legends|Hound's Tooth]]'' modified for his [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] physiology. Troughs on the ship's control grid were lined with microsensors, allowing them to respond to Bossk's every move which in turn allowed him to control the ship with little effort.<ref name="EGVV" />

Individuals who had the [[At-cyb husher mike]] surgically inserted near their [[Larynx/Legends|larynx]] also had microsensors implanted into their [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
